__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The killer frog looks ravenous.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A killer frog rises up out of the water.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle killer frog

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: As you look, the figure seems to shift and move ...
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A stone gargoyle looms over you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle stone gargoyle

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He looks ready to attack!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An angry gargoyle glares at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle angry gargoyle

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He snarls at you and says LEAVE OR DIE!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An elite gargoyle guards this room against intrusion.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle elite gargoyle

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: She says 'I can SEE you! I have been waiting ...'.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The gargoyle shaman is here, preparing to do battle.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle gargoyle shaman

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The plant looks something like a Venus fly-trap, only MUCH larger.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Amidst the jungle here, a huge Carnivorous plant reaches out to grab you!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle carnivorous plant

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: It thinks that perhaps you would make a better meal.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A huge, gruesome ogre is sprawled here, gnawing some strange meat.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle gruesome ogre

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The Shadow is vaguely humanoid. Two glowing pinpoints look at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A dark shadow moves about the room.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle shadow

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He glares at you savagely and charges!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An evil wight lurks in the shadows!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle evil wight

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: This powerful creature wonders whether to kill you or not ...
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A burly minotaur watches you solemnly.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle burly minotaur

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He looks up at you and screams 'SO! Coming to steal my hoard!'
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A bloodthirsty minotaur slowly counts his loot
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle savage minotaur

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He looks at you, and a sinister grin slowly spreads on his face ...
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Sitting here in this room is the Minotaur Captain.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle minotaur captain

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: It is a huge black blob that oozes about the room. Its heading toward YOU!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A huge black pudding fills the center of the room!!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle black pudding

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The golem appears to be made of some kind of clay, enchanted to come to life!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A lesser Golem stands guarding the entrance.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle lesser golem

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: It thunders loudly 'I must protect my Master's wealth!'
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An enormous, ancient wyvern stares down at your tiny form...
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle ancient wyvern

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: Terror fills your heart as you view this master of the undead.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A spectre has begun to materialize in front of you!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle spectre

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The trapper is clad mostly in the fur of various animals he's caught.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A trapper stands here, bartering his pelts.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle trapper

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The hunter is rugged and sturdy from his occupation.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A hunter rests in here, carrying a fresh kill.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle hunter

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The years of wanderings have left the ranger hardened and strong.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A grim ranger reclines at a table.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle ranger

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: This individual has quite a reputation at the local trading posts!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A leader of the Rangers is watching you solemnly.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle ranger leader

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Lord of the Rangers catches your eye.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle ranger lord

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The centaur has the upper torso of a man and lower body of a horse.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A male centaur wanders about this area.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle male centaur

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The centaur has the upper torso of a woman and lower body of a horse.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A female centaur wanders about this area.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle female centaur

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: This centaur has lived a full life.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An old centaur is resting in a corner.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle old centaur

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The elders act as counselors and advisors to the chief.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: One of the centaur elders is here, watching you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle centaur elder

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He appears to be blocking entrance to the next room.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A strong centaur is standing guard here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle centaur guard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He has been the leader of this tribe for many years, and has acquired much
wisdom.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The chief of the centaur villagers reclines here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle centaur chief

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: As you watch this strange creature, its position seems to flicker and shift.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A displacer beast is grazing nearby.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle displacer beast
